prompts.name: file-headers

prompts.title: Specification Edge Case Discovery (Six-Boundary Protocol)

prompts.name: adversarial-stakeholder-evaluation
prompts.title: Adversarial Stakeholder Evaluation
prompts.description: Three-tier adversarial evaluation of proposals: stakeholder council, anti-persona stress testing, pre-mortem with contradiction analysis.

prompts.name: formal-verification-evaluator
prompts.title: Formal Verification Readiness Evaluator
prompts.description: Evaluate specs for formal-verification readiness: paradigm, safety/liveness properties, invalidity risk, toolchain choice, scoping.

prompts.name: doc-link-verifier
prompts.title: Documentation Link Verifier
prompts.description: Audit docs for broken links and contextual correctness: HTTP status, relative paths, anchors, and link-text/target mismatches.

prompts.name: systematic-housekeeping
prompts.title: Systematic Repository Housekeeping (5S Protocol)
prompts.description: Comprehensive repository maintenance across Code/CI, Documentation, Prompts/Skills, and Context/Artifacts using 5S principles

prompts.name: grill-me
prompts.title: Grill Me
prompts.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until shared understanding is reached

prompts.name: anti-slop-prose
prompts.title: Anti-Slop Prose Audit
prompts.description: Tag AI-generated prose for overused vocabulary, formulaic constructions, and vague claims — advisory-only, no rewrites.

prompts.name: whisper
prompts.title: Whisper — Accumulated Operational Knowledge
prompts.description: Knowledge workspace management: init, check, status, link plan, decommission, routing. Delegates to the turu CLI when installed.

prompts.name: project-status-report
prompts.title: Evidence-Backed Project Status Report
prompts.description: Create audience-specific project status reports grounded in evidence, variance, blockers, decisions, and agentic AI provenance when applicable

prompts.name: codebase-cartography
prompts.title: Codebase Cartography
prompts.description: Map a codebase's structure as text-based architecture diagrams at macro, meso, and micro zoom levels, with optional structural-health triage.

prompts.name: session
prompts.title: Session Lifecycle
prompts.description: Session lifecycle: end-of-session wrap-up and commit (close), quick stash (next), park before context switch, renew to resume prior work, create or resume handoff documents. Trigger for closing, wrapping up, parking, resuming, or handoffs.

prompts.name: review
prompts.title: Review Router
prompts.description: Multi-pass reviews of code, plans, specs, or docs: general code review, Rule-of-5 iterative refinement, parallel agent review waves, multi-agent coordination, adversarial red-team pass, guided teaching review. Trigger on review requests.

prompts.name: planning
prompts.title: Planning Router
prompts.description: Implementation planning: create a phased TDD-oriented plan, implement it phase by phase, review a plan for gaps and risks, or iterate it from feedback. Trigger for planning or executing multi-phase work.

prompts.name: issues
prompts.title: Issues Router
prompts.description: Issue tracking: create trackable issues from an implementation plan, or review existing issues for completeness, dependencies, and executability. Trigger for breaking work into issues or checking issue quality.

prompts.name: diagnostician
prompts.title: Diagnostician Router
prompts.description: Advisory-only diagnostics, no code changes: modularity, rigidity, mutability, invalid states, composability, error handling, Julia performance, UX/DX evaluation, spec evaluation, testability, verification, root-cause analysis.

prompts.name: prompt-meta
prompts.title: Prompt-Meta Router
prompts.description: Prompt engineering on this repo: extract a reusable prompt from a successful interaction, distill it to token-efficient form, verify the distilled version preserved essential instructions. Trigger for capture/distill/verify prompt work.

prompts.name: documentation
prompts.title: Documentation Router
prompts.description: Documentation suites: audit or plan docs, write with Diátaxis/Info Mapping/EPPO, review for scannability and AI-readiness. Trigger for doc planning, writing, or review. Broken links are doc-link-verifier, not this.
